difficulty_reason: The four lemma gives two surjectivity and injectivity conclusions for a commutative diagram with exact rows (statement lines 1396-1413). The proof is a complete argument for the first assertion: two preparatory replacements reduce to a situation with a convenient injectivity and surjectivity (proof lines 1416-1421), the snake lemma applied to the kernel square of the right-hand pair of maps gives the surjectivity of the induced map between kernels (proof lines 1422-1430), and a second application of the snake lemma, now using that kernel as the third column, gives the surjectivity of the map between the second entries (proof lines 1431-1438); the second assertion follows by duality. The non-formal content is the choice of the two diagrams to which the snake lemma is applied. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
